name: printing-press-tiktok-cli
description: Agent-native social CLI harness, starting with TikTok.

scripts.smoke: node src/cli.mjs --help && node src/cli.mjs profile list --json && node src/cli.mjs post tiktok --profile smoke --text "hello" --media test/fixtures/sample.mp4 --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs comment tiktok --profile smoke --url https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123 --text "nice" --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs dm tiktok --profile smoke --to testuser --text "hello" --dry-run --json
